reasoning: On the season so far the Timberwolves are the stronger team; with home court the Timberwolves start about 4 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Timberwolves.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Timberwolves win 68 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 204 and 253 total points.

analyst.text: Memphis have won five straight and are 8-0 on the road. Ty Jerome was upgraded to probable after a hip issue, though Cameron Boozer, Jerami Grant and others are out. Minnesota are still without Anthony Edwards after knee surgery and come off a late collapse at the Knicks, when they went scoreless after cutting a 16-point deficit to three. The angle leans slightly towards Memphis.
